shortDescription: Communicates a custom prometheus metrics to an Operator SDK metrics server

options.name: address
options.description: The addresss of the Operator SDK metrics server

options.name: counter
options.description: Instructs the controller to create a prometheus counter metric

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the prometheus metric, used for help text

options.name: gauge
options.description: Instructs the controller to create a prometheus gauge metric

options.name: histogram
options.description: Instructs the controller to create a prometheus histogram metric

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the prometheus metric to be created or updated

options.name: summary
options.description: Instructs the controller to create a prometheus summary metric
